page.overview:
Who is Bagaraatan?

is an extinct genus of pantyrannosaur theropod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous in what is now Mongolia. It is the natural enemy to Adasaurus and Tarbosaurus.

Bagaraatan is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia of the Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006.
